overview: A successful and confident woman, Kang Ji Yun, is the CEO of a headhunting company. To survive in the fiercely competitive headhunting field, she puts everything she has into her work. Outside of her job, she doesn't know how to do anything. She has a secretary named Yoo Eun Ho who takes care of pretty much everything for her. Unlike his boss, the secretary is friendly, well-mannered, and considerate of other people. He is a single father, who is also good at parenting and housework.
title: Love Scout

overview: Mysterious Islands takes viewers on an unforgettable adventure to explore the most enigmatic islands on the planet. Weaving together CGI, archival footage, and expert testimony—and with up to four incredible stories per one-hour episode—it's a wild ride as these incredible outposts gradually reveal their secrets.
title: Mysterious Islands

overview: "He's an old pig." "You could have been his mother." "Find someone your own age." We follow four couples who open up about a taboo in the innermost and most intimate part of their lives - they have found love with someone who is significantly older than themselves. The age difference between them often goes to the limit in relation to what many believe is appropriate in a love relationship.
title: De unge kærester

overview: A show in which guests will talk about their favorite books, we will check how well they understand literature and share recommendations on which books are worth reading and which are better left in the store.
title: Читатели

overview: Song Cha fell in love with Wan Ni at first sight, and snatched Wan Ni and Hu En's bride on their wedding day, and forcefully married Wan Ni. After the marriage, Song Cha protected his wife domineeringly, and Wan Ni was gradually moved by Song Cha. When Hu En learned that Wan Ni had changed her mind, he felt jealous and accidentally killed Wan Ni's father and framed the blame on Song Cha. The three of them faced off in an abandoned factory. Hu En wanted to kill the two of them, but Song Cha counterattacked. In the end, the police arrived and punished Hu En. Song Cha got his wish after pursuing his wife, but he was also punished for the crime he committed.
title: After the Flash Marriage, I Was in the Hands of the Big Man

overview: The story happened after the departure of Ever 9, who fell in love with a human. The leader of the Ever series, Ever 4, in order to fight for his rights as an AI, was sent to the Luo family as a deacon and bodyguard. Facing the rebellious young master of the family, Luo Bu Shi, how can Ever 4, who is used to being in control, keep his young master in line? Due to his family's financial situation, Lin Jia Qian worked at construction sites and delivery during school breaks, as well as at a cafe during holidays. One time Lin Jia Qian was being chased by a gangster on his way to collect a debt, he bumped into Zhou Zhen Qun. Lin Jia Qian recognised at first sight that Zhou Zhen Qun was the person he had been waiting for, and this fated encounter started.
title: Eternal Butler

overview: Donna only wanted a nice, casual sex date, but her chosen one, Pascal, is a man-influencer for whom she's nothing more than another item in his 7-one-night-in-7-day challenge. Without her consent, he films her naked in bed and even streams the whole thing. But Donna literally strikes back by kicking Pascal in the groin on camera. The video goes viral, and so does Donna. At first, it looks like her life is ruined. But Donna isn't so easily defeated. With her best friend and roommate, Milou, she makes her own video and launches a counterattack against pick-up artist Pascal and all the toxic incels on the internet. She announces that within a month she'll have more followers than Pascal—a mere 1.5 million, after all.
title: Bad Influencer

overview: Like everyone else, Iris has a head. Only her head... isn't exactly like everyone else's. And neither is her mouth, which says things that other mouths don't say. Her boyfriend, her cousin, a wine merchant, a museum guard. The list of those she pushes to the limit grows every day. But ultimately, the first to suffer is Iris.
title: Iris

overview: Which of America's best bakers can master mind-blowingly inventive, visually stunning, decadently delicious desserts in three top sweets categories? Every standalone episode of this totally fresh, utterly appealing dessert competition series challenges pro baker-decorators to conquer the three "C's" of sweets in escalating rounds of detail, flavor complexity, and grandeur. Welcome to Cookie Cupcake Cake!
title: Cookie Cupcake Cake

overview: Buddy Valastro hosts Cake Toppers, a cake competition with a wicked twist! Round one, artists create detailed cakes; round two the final teams must swap cakes and elevate designs! It's a game of artistry, strategy, and cake engineering asking, can you top that?
title: Cake Toppers

overview: In a gripping new Court TV original documentary series, host David Scott (HBO Real Sports, ABC News) ventures inside high-security prisons to delve into the minds of convicted murderers. Through in-depth interviews and direct confrontations, Scott seeks to uncover the motives and mindsets that led these individuals to commit murder. The series offers a rare glimpse into the psychological and emotional factors driving heinous crimes, providing viewers with a chilling yet insightful look at some of the most dangerous criminals behind bars.
title: Interview with a Killer

overview: A storm is coming for happily married attorneys Anna and Tom Bowden when Max Cady, the notorious killer they are responsible for putting behind bars, is let out of prison - and he wants vengeance.
title: Cape Fear

overview: What would happen if the strange events in world history happened today? People taking photos with their dead relatives, methods that enable men to feel the pain of women's birth, interesting rules in the first Olympics... Anonim searches for the answer to this question through different examples.
title: Anonim

overview: Luca's Key Ingredient is an exciting seven-part cooking show where each episode Chef Luca Ciano will take your taste buds on a journey showcasing some exceptional Italian and Australian produce. He will share some insights on some key ingredient history and plate up meals that will leave you feeling true Italian love on a plate.
title: Luca's Key Ingredient

overview: Fang Meng, who has had a misaligned sense of taste since childhood, takes over the struggling 'Hua Su' restaurant after her father's death. With the help of Shu Zhengyan, she continuously tries and works hard. From a beginner who could only make 'dark cuisine,' she finally succeeds in turning 'Hua Su' into the most iconic restaurant in the city. After overcoming numerous hardships, she and Shu Zhengyan share a life together.
title: Almost Delicious

overview: A trip along the Yangtze River from Shanghai to Shangri-la, through the Three Gorges, documenting the amazing sights and experiences in that region.
title: Charming China

overview: Gu Ping'an arrives in Qiantang to investigate an unsolved case left by his late father. There, he encounters Song Shirui, who is troubled by the "single tax" she has to pay. The two pretend to be a married couple and open a restaurant together. During their journey as business partners, they develop feelings for each other, overcome fierce competition in the restaurant industry, and uncover the criminal forces entrenched in Qiantang. Together, they bring justice to Gu Ping'an's father's unresolved case.
title: My Contractual Husband

overview: Join Gavin Hurley as he breaks down the secrets of the fly fishing artform while taking you to some of the world's most amazing destinations. From a sparkling stream just out of a busy city, a fish rich river in the mountains, or a sand flat in literally the centre of the ocean, every fish you target can be caught on a fly and Gavin will show you how On the Fly.
title: On the Fly

overview: At both ends of the Milky Way reside the Emperors of the North and South, masters of life and death for all beings. One day, amid a game of strategy, a wager is struck with "romance" as the stake, placing life and death at the mercy of heaven's trials. The Northern Dipper's Mystic Pearl descends to the mortal realm to endure three lifetimes of trials by love.
title: Calling from the Galaxy

overview: Doctor in the House is a British television comedy series based on a set of books and a film of the same name by Richard Gordon about the misadventures of a group of medical students. It was produced by London Weekend Television from 1969 to 1970.
title: Doctor in the House

overview: Ren Kosaka arrives in Japan to take up a special temporary lecturer position at an art university in Kamakura, Japan. He is a young and talented artist, who has a certain aura about him to make people want to get closer to him, but he also keeps a certain distance from everyone around him. Like butterflies that surround a flower, he is surrounded by other people. One day, he meets a certain woman and, because of her, his emotions begin to change. Even though he knows it will hurt ... nevertheless.
title: Nevertheless: The Shapes of Love

overview: The adventures of toys who come to life when no-one's watching.
title: The Toy Castle

overview: Moonward: A Midst Roleplaying Story is a four-part mini-series set shortly after the events of the Midst podcast and features a cast of characters on an unsanctioned rescue mission to the sunken remains of Midst's destroyed moon. Only problem is this moon currently resides in a cosmic ocean of spooky darkness known as the Fold and the Fold is filled with tearrors that cause unknown reality-bending mayhem to those exposed… What could possibly go wrong ? Are you with us so far ?
title: Moonward

overview: Kerim's relationship with Ecrin, the daughter of the person he thinks is his father's murderer, starts with hostility and moves to another level, and the two young people start working together to find the real murderer. Kerim and Ecrin, who become more attached to each other with every obstacle they encounter, soon fall into an impossible love.
title: Bir Yemin Ettim

overview: Logre, the famous ogre who reigns over the magical creatures of the kingdom of Logres, takes a very dim view of the quest for the Grail in which Arthur has embarked. He therefore decides to set up a machine to reduce the powers of Merlin, the famous enchanter. Odilon, an archer of the King, learns of the stratagem. Helped by Alan the bard, he will do everything to thwart the plans of the King of Brocéliande. On their way, they will meet a series of colorful characters like Blööm and Pace, two elves trying to cover up the crime of a knight of the Round Table that they have committed; as well as Ferrigno and Zif, an orc and a goblin, soldiers of the army of Logre.
title: Brocéliande

overview: Join Pat Callinan as he explores some of the most amazing and visually stunning places in Australia on Pat Callinan's 4×4 Adventures.
title: Pat Callinan's 4×4 Adventures

overview: A small-town feud, an internet conspiracy, an Elvis impersonator, black market body parts, and an assassination attempt on the President. Welcome to Mississippi where this jaw-dropping story spirals from local drama to a national scandal. Buckle up for a wild ride. This isn't fiction — it's Tupelo.
title: The Kings of Tupelo: A Southern Crime Saga

overview: Featuring the voice of Jason Sudeikis, Son of Zorn is a new hybrid live-action/animated comedy. Upon arriving home on Earth for the first time in 10 years, ZORN, a fully animated, legendary warrior, finds that reconnecting with his live-action son, ALAN, and ex-wife, EDIE, while suffering through a mundane office job and the banality of suburban life, is harder than waging actual war in his distant, mystical homeland of Zephyria.
title: Son of Zorn

overview: The Qld Murri Carnival is an annual four-day rugby league carnival for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders Queensland rugby league teams.
title: Murri Rugby League Carnival 2024

overview: Transblack follows the day-to-day life of four Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander transgender men and women.
title: Transblack

overview: If the love of your life was by your side the whole time, how long would it take for you to realize it? Bruna Marquezine and Sérgio Malheiros star in this irresistible romantic comedy about the ups and downs of Bia and Victor, their love lives, and unshakable friendship.
title: Amor da Minha Vida

overview: Mamen Mayo and her mediation team attempt to resolve conflicts of interest within families entangled in inheritance disputes.
title: Mamen Mayo

overview: Parents confront their kid's wildest dreams as they give over control for an entire day.
title: The Yes Experiment

overview: Sustainability stories about innovating, adapting and changing the way we live and work. Presenters Laura Wells and Jo Taranto travel across Australia to hear first hand from people making real change. The need to be more sustainable is now an accepted part of life. From recycling waste at home, to large scale renewable energy, there is innovation and change all around us. Planet Shapers reveals the people and organisations leading the way. Sharing knowledge and inspiring others to live and work more sustainably.
title: Planet Shapers

overview: Carom is a situation in billiards when a ball bouncing off another ball must ricochet into the third. The world is small, and evil deeds, as well as good ones, certainly affect the fate of third people and, as a result, can turn into the most unexpected side - Natalya Silantyeva is a beautiful, young, successful owner of a modeling agency. A loving husband, a wonderful son, a beloved job - what else is needed for happiness? But the quiet life comes to an end when it turns out that her first husband, who was presumed dead, is actually alive. Now too many people want to find him, hoping to reach him through Natalya.
title: Карамболь

overview: Cutting through the glamour and glory of the MMA spectacle to reveal never-before-told stories behind its fighters.
title: Dark Side of the Cage

overview: It's Not Like That follows Lori, who is freshly divorced with two teens. Malcolm's a minister and recently widowed dad of three. Their families once did everything together, but now Lori and Malcolm must navigate their newly minted singledom, parenthood and the complexities of Malcolm being a modern-day minister. Is this the beginning of a love story? It's not like that. Or is it?
title: It's Not Like That

overview: It explores different stories set in a place and see how each of their paths leads to 'Ekam'; defined not as one, but where everything comes together as one.
title: Ekam

overview: An Icelandic series based on the book Kviknar, which covers conception, pregnancy, childbirth, and postpartum recovery. Kviknar is a blend of factual information, personal stories, and answers to common questions.
title: Líf kviknar

overview: Before the spread of social media and easy access to online porn, Joe Francis' multi-million dollar "Girls Gone Wild" franchise, a series of tapes sold on late night television that featured young spring breakers baring their breasts for T-shirts and hats, had a shocking grip on popular culture. Including Francis' first in-depth, in-person, on-the-record interview with a journalist in almost a decade, as well as exclusive access to his former employees, enemies, and survivors, Girls Gone Wild: The Untold Story offers an astonishing and wide-ranging account of a man whose impact on American culture cannot be overstated, whose alleged sins are numerous, and who now lives in exile on a sprawling estate in Mexico amidst the rubble of his once mighty empire.
title: Girls Gone Wild: The Untold Story

overview: Watch the action unfold in this gripping football documentary series, where global icons join local stars to reshape the league in its 2023/2024 season.
title: Saudi Pro League: Kickoff

overview: Get ready to embark on a transformative journey of creativity and resilience when Budget Battlers premieres on Wednesday, December 4, at 8.30pm on Channel 9 and 9Now. Hosted by former Block favourites, Jess Eva and Norm Hogan, this groundbreaking new series tackles full-blown makeovers with an unprecedented challenge: transforming four different Aussie homes in four weeks on the tightest budget yet seen on Australian television. As inflation, soaring living costs and interest rate increases keep the idea of home renovation out of reach for many, Budget Battlers arrives to prove that dreams can still come true – on a budget. The Budget Battlers team gears up with just $10,000 per home, a group of selfless volunteers and only five working days, to inspire viewers with jaw-dropping transformations, changing the lives of those who need it the most.
title: Budget Battlers

overview: Newly separated investigator Irene has to reinvent herself in her late 40s. Not so easy when you have Julia, her husband's lover, as a colleague.
title: Kolleginnen

overview: Cameras capture Venice from the air to demonstrate how the rising waters shape this incredible city and the secret engineering that makes it possible.
title: Venice From Above

overview: Scheming killers call 999, set out to escape justice, deceive police and lie about committing murder, only to be damned by their own words. Detectives unravel the false trails and deception within the 999 call to expose the trust and catch the killer.
title: 999 Murderer Calling

overview: Black couples fuse modern trends and proud cultural heritage to create the dream wedding.
title: Our Big Day

overview: Deion Sanders and Rocsi Diaz discuss the latest in news, culture, entertainment, and sports as well as conduct interviews with celebrity guests.
title: We Got Time Today

overview: Editor Xiao Qiu had just finished evaluating a cringe-worthy Mary Sue novel and firmly rejected it during the approval meeting. However, after taking a quick nap in her wardrobe, she wakes up in another world. To her shock, she realizes she has transmigrated into the very novel she had dismissed and has become the unluckiest supporting character, Shen Qingge! Although she has the author's "golden cheat" ability to see everyone's luck value, her own luck is disastrously low, attracting all kinds of misfortune. The novel's system informs her that only by staying close to the "lucky charm" male lead, Gu Yichen, can her luck value increase—and only then will she have a chance to return home.
title: Misfortune Miss and Lucky Mr

overview: The gang criminals Yousef, Elias and Alex are all three in prison and are stuck in a vicious cycle of violence and crime. Inside the institution, a life and death power struggle is going on: who is your friend and who can you really trust? Through the conversations with the prison psychologist, hope arises for a better life - but how difficult is it to break away from a criminal lifestyle and take the step to another life?
title: Från Insidan

overview: Zuhal Soydaşlı is a mother of three, married to Hasan,a man emotionally distant and shaped by a troubled childhood. After discovering his infidelity, Zuhal, once a respected officer, struggles to rebuild her life and care for her children.
title: Annem Ankara

overview: In South Africa's first dating show of its kind, six couples face temptations — and a ruthless lie detector — in the ultimate relationship test.
title: Love Never Lies: South Africa

overview: A distant father and son are brought together by a twist of fate that sends Lin Zihao back to his father Lin Jiaxu's 18-year-old self, into the golden era of the 90s. Here, Zihao discovers a different side of his father, and the two even become "best buddies." Together, they navigate the highs and lows of youth, with Zihao using his knowledge of the future to revive the spirit of Engor and create a business legend in this vibrant era.
title: Engor Dreams at 18

overview: Criminal Minds revolves around an elite team of FBI profilers who analyze the country's most twisted criminal minds, anticipating their next moves before they strike again.
title: Criminal Minds

overview: In Plain Sight follows the story of a Federal Marshall with the Witness Protection program who must hide her high-risk, high-impact job from her family. To those that know her, Mary Shannon is a glorified meter maid, but her real job is much more dangerous. She must oversee federal witnesses who have been relocated through the Witness Protection program and make sure that they stay safe.
title: In Plain Sight

overview: Larry King is a convenience store owner in Toronto's Kensington Market who was known for helping friends and neighbours solve problems. His multicultural group of friends consist of Nestor Best, Max, and Tony "Duke" Zarro, who hang around regularly to the perennial disapproval of King's mother Gladys.
title: King of Kensington

overview: For years Alison worked as a tour rep following in the footsteps of her mother, who was a hard-working, no-nonsense travel agent. Her passion for travel will take audiences of this new series on a journey with her son Aidan. The pair will embark on an adventure-packed exploration of Florida, unveiling the state's hidden gems and providing viewers with practical and budget-friendly travel advice.
title: Alison Hammond's Florida Unpacked

overview: Pennies is about a reclusive forensic pathologist named Penny who is more comfortable with the bodies under her (dogged) care than with real people. Penny solves mysteries and murders stemming from the San Francisco morgue, aided by her over-confident extrovert sister, also named Penny, an attorney in the D.A.'s office.
title: Pennies

overview: Toys "R" Us Family Faceoff will seek families competing inside a "larger-than-life" toy store and will integrate a range of nostalgic and popular trending toys and games from classic toy brands.
title: Toys "R" Us Family Faceoff

overview: On one side, a talented young man with a strong sense of justice who sees his dreams threatened. On the other, a brilliant surgeon with explosive doses of cynicism, trying to return to surgery after a trauma. United by an unexpected and dangerous situation, they end up forming an unbeatable medical duo.
title: Sutura: A Vida por um Fio

overview: Petr Kratov is a former military surgeon, a luminary of medicine. A former respected member of society, a former exemplary family man. Now Petr works as a paramedic in an ambulance team, and lives in the house of his eldest son Viktor - the head of the department for combating drug trafficking. Victor, out of a sense of filial duty, pulled his father out of the bottom, paid for treatment at a clinic for addiction, settled him in his place, and found a job for his father through friends. In the ambulance, Kratov is half-jokingly called Hippocrates - because of the rhyme with the surname and for his morbid commitment to the oath to help any patient in need of help. A redistribution of the drug market is taking place in the city, and Kratov, against his will, is forced not only to help the leader of a criminal group, of which his youngest son is a member, but also to hide his affairs from his son, a policeman, who is determined to destroy this group.
title: Последняя клятва Гиппократа

overview: A gruesome crime has occurred in La Pedrera - Casa Milà: a burning body appears on the façade of Gaudi's emblematic building. Inspector Milo Malart, until now suspended from his job, comes back to activity and, hand in hand with deputy inspector Rebeca Garrido, will try to find the author of this crime.
title: Ciudad de sombras

overview: The cameras never stop rolling in the Big Brother Canada house. From secret alliances to houseguest hook-ups, Big Brother Canada After Dark catches all the late-night action.
title: Big Brother Canada After Dark

overview: The pandemic and the success of startup culture have sparked the emergence of new hubs for businesses outside of traditional power centers of New York, Chicago, Houston and San Francisco. These Cities of Success each have used unique characteristics – pop culture influence, clusters of great universities, friendly geography or forward-thinking local governments – to attract major companies and nurture an entrepreneurial community around them.
title: Cities of Success

overview: They Call It Late Night with Jason Kelce will be an immersive experience from Union Transfer in Philadelphia, showcasing the Super Bowl champion's oversized personality and infectious humor mixed with celebrity guests from the football world and beyond, in front of a live audience of NFL fans. The show's format will position Kelce and his guests to dissect NFL topics and storylines, mainly focused on that weekend's games, in both conventional and good-humoredly unconventional approaches including active participation from the fans in attendance.
title: They Call It Late Night with Jason Kelce

overview: In the past, the Empress Dowager, in her quest for power, schemed to change Feng Yi's gender, forcing Feng Yi to live a life disguised as a man. Upon reaching adulthood, unwilling to remain a puppet emperor, Feng Yi began to cultivate her own strength. However, her attempts to curry favor with the Prime Minister ended in the Prime Minister's sudden death at a brothel. When she tried to win over the Grand Tutor Sima Qi, he repeatedly attempted to kill her. This is the bitter and tragic life of a woman ruling as the emperor, where a single misstep could cost her life.
title: Feng Yi's World

overview: Hua Zhaoyang of the Human Moon Sect has spent five hundred years in seclusion, breaking through to the Heavenly Realm and defeating his arch-nemesis, the Asura Ye Tian. To truly become a Heavenly Being, Hua Zhaoyang must fulfill Ye Tian's last wish: to save and prevent him from becoming an Asura. Hua Zhaoyang seals his spirit into a jade and begins a cycle of reincarnation to find Ye Tian's past life, eliminate his malevolence, and awaken him.
title: The Dawn to the Night

overview: Renaissance: The Blood and the Beauty explores the lives of three rival artists - Michelangelo, Leonardo and Raphael – who created seductively beautiful works of art during an age of violence and upheaval. Featuring contributions from contemporary artists Antony Gormley, Alison Lapper, David LaChapelle, a host of experts and a star turn from Charles Dance as the older Michelangelo, this landmark series reveals how some of history's greatest works of art, from Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa to Michelangelo's David, emerged from an era of brutality and bloodshed.
title: Renaissance: The Blood and the Beauty

overview: Psychologist Evgeniya, who leaves her former life in the metropolis with her family and returns to her hometown, because the local healing climate is ideal for the health of her teenage daughter. Zhenya's husband believes that here, far from everyone, they will finally be happy. However, in her native land, the heroine unexpectedly meets Artyom, her first love, and feelings flare up with a new force that they cannot resist. But neither Artyom's wife nor Zhenya's husband intend to let them go so easily.
title: Омут

overview: Andrei Potyomkin, frontier guard cadet, learns that his MIA father who fought in the Soviet-Afghan war is accused of treason. He is trying to find out the truth about his father's death, and together with a young promising journalist Alyona Nikitina, exposes a criminal group of servicemen who trade missiles to mojaheddin and terrorists. They are not ready to let their profitable business go easily...
title: Афганский призрак

overview: Lera is happily married, raising her son Nikita and teaching dance at the best studio in the city. Her son also studies there. Lera is proud of him and prepares him for a dance competition. But one day Nikita decides to go skateboarding, flies out onto the road and breaks his leg. And then he tells his mother that he was hit by a man with a car. Lera decides to find and punish the culprit at all costs. To top it all off, her husband Andrey tells her about her divorce, he started an affair with his boss and leaves the family. Meanwhile, Angela decides to learn a wedding dance, brings her fiancé Ilya to Lera's studio and makes him learn to dance. Lera soon falls in love with her new student and does not suspect that he is the very person she is looking for.
title: Танец для двоих

overview: The film will tell the story of an old summer cottage village, the residents of which have been friends with their families for several generations in a row. Together they meet new summer cottage seasons, celebrate holidays, cope with troubles and failures. Nika Mstislavova, the heiress of one of the oldest summer residents, who died under rather strange circumstances, settles in the house of her late grandmother and sets herself the goal of finding out the true nature of the mysterious and terrible events taking place in the village... Nika is immediately overwhelmed by a mass of impressions, new and already forgotten, because the girl grew up in these places, here she was raised by her grandmother after the sudden death of her parents. Many of the faces she meets on the street seem almost family, although these people have changed a lot and aged since Nika left for Moscow. Familiar and unfamiliar summer residents make up a narrow circle of old-timers, many of whom remember and love Nika's grandmother, Veronika Vitoldova, but no one wants to even admit that a real crime could happen in their quiet and cozy little world. However, Nika does not have to fight for her rights alone. Her common-law husband, the famous Moscow writer Pavlov, and the young architect Vetlitsky, who is building luxurious houses for representatives of the prosperous new elite in the village, are always by her side. They quickly realize that the roots of the crimes go back to the village's past sixty years ago...
title: Омут

overview: Suburban Shootout chronicles the exercise classes and carpools of suburban housewives with a dark twist – they kill each other. Camilla Diamond and Barbara Du Prez are two power hungry housewives locked in a vicious battle, each with their own team of women who are highly armed and combat-ready.
title: Suburban Shootout

overview: The Sing Sing Chronicles is a four-episode exposé built on two-decades of original investigative reporting with unprecedented access to one of America's most notorious prisons. Crafted from an archive of more than 1,000 hours of footage filmed from 2002 to present day, the series tells the story of a journalist and a man convicted of murder who begin as strangers but become like brothers. Their unlikely connection, forged in the cell blocks of Sing Sing Correctional Facility, ignites a search for justice in four unrelated homicide cases.
title: The Sing Sing Chronicles
